payload.body: PR #13 (Phase 1 core loop) proved the cross-vendor review pattern later codified in Phase 2 decision C: Codex adversarial review found 6 real findings, all fixed red-first; 3 rounds total to sign-off; merge executed under Jim's pre-authorized merge-on-approve. Disposition replies posted per finding. This is the empirical basis for the two-reviewer loop with fix/re-loop cap and per-project merge authority.
